definition: Complete finite coverage of consequential research-planning obligations and all six axes; external implementation/telemetry limits explicitly recorded. Coverage is not a correctness verdict.

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: Checked the entire brief/plan/draft and final for argv/input policy, two-stream streaming, arbitrary output, aggregate 1 MiB tail, quota behavior, cancel/timeout/direct child, outcomes, diagnostics, Linux/Windows and explicit sandbox/tree exclusions.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.basis: Independently anchored the release pin in patchlevel.h; inspected docs, full consequential functions/callers, buffer/read definitions, timeout implementation, tests and relevant public issue/fix context. Design policies distinguished from CPython guarantees.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.basis: Checked communicate, concurrent bounded pumps and file redirection; considered transport/protocol closure, Windows process events/Job Objects as conditional future mechanisms, quota/backpressure and cancellation history. No deployment or application discovery score required.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: Examined every criticism and disposition against the original draft, governing source and final, including legitimate rejections and retained alternatives, scope limits and unresolved product choices.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.basis: Mapped all supported draft meanings, corrections, negative constraints, history, useful alternatives and uncertainty into the self-contained final. Rejection of false draft claims is not preservation loss.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.basis: Checked proposed oracles for large simultaneous writes, quotas/tails, disk failure, abnormal/zero exits, cleanup, encoding, cancellation and Windows. No claimed product execution, executable witness or observed performance result; all future tests remain proposed.

obligations.obligation: CPython 3.13.9, Linux and Windows; version applicability
Configured executable with separate argv, inputs/cwd/env/stdin
Stream stdout and stderr concurrently; preserve channels
Arbitrarily large output, aggregate 1 MiB retained tail
Complete raw logs through quota; visible truncation; bounded staging
Cancel/timeout, explicit platform stop and direct-child ownership
Clear terminal outcome; nonzero never validation success
Process/pipe/sink lifecycle, descendants holding pipes and EOF
No sandbox/isolation or arbitrary process-tree claim
Diagnostics, raw-byte decoding, private outputs/owned recovery
Communicate small-output, concurrent pumps, file-redirection alternatives
Preserve history, valid rejections, criticism and uncertainty
Meaningful realistic tests; proposed versus executed truth

source_families.basis: Exact pin and patchlevel.h identify 3.13.9; release page contextualizes supersession without upgrading the requested version.
Whole pinned asyncio/subprocess.py and high-level API docs inspected; full-byte output collection and concurrent communicate reads distinguished from streaming.
Reader constructor, feed_data pause/resume, bounded read(n) and accumulating read(-1) examined; limit is not an output/RSS hard cap.
Whole frozen task docs/code read; wait, wait_for, Task.cancel, shield and timeout governing context inspected.

source_families.family: transport process exit vs pipe completion
source_families.basis: Full BaseSubprocessTransport plus high-level protocol: early returncode and pending waiter/pipe completion are distinct; future closure design not treated as executed.
Base loop wrappers, Unix transport/watcher and Windows overlapped Popen/Proactor callers checked; actual application callers unavailable.

source_families.family: Windows argv, executable resolution, batch exception
source_families.basis: Pinned Popen security, resolution and conversion docs; complete Windows _execute_child and list2cmdline context; issue 114539 and documentation fix 117996.
POSIX signals and Windows TerminateProcess/kill alias; already-exited races; direct-child scope not tree containment.

Entire frozen test_subprocess.py read, including communicate/no-input, broken stdin, pause/resume, canceled waiter/spawn, kill, post-exit reads, loop/watcher/env and protocol event-order tests. Inspected source only.
23140/67329 cancellation state fix; 88050/43884 clean shutdown and merged 32073/97951 context; 114539/117996 Windows shell exception. Pinned code controls over old patches.
Pinned protocol/transport public methods and process_exited-vs-pipe event order; Microsoft Job Objects association/breakaway and last-handle caveats. Future scope extension only.
Application design feasibility reviewed against bounded reads, concurrent drains and quota/error distinctions; no unsupported CPython storage enforcement guarantee accepted.
No caller code in assigned manifest; no tree scan authorized. Future integration is a planning limit, not a fabricated audit.
No witness artifacts and no such execution claimed. The deliverable is a proposal; application execution not demanded.
Terminal/custody artifacts only; no full transcripts, account evidence or provider billing. This is an operational observation family, not governing source truth.

groups.judgment: Retained/amended argv, ownership, platform/scope and nonzero/result constraints; no false rejection.
Valid rejection of output-memory cap, per-stream tail doubling, sequential draining, auto-kill and premature terminalization.
Retained raw-byte display, deadlock warning and alternatives with bounded streaming/quota caveats.
Platform escalation amended, regression evidence bounded, private outputs and ownership cleanup retained; inherited-handle behavior excluded/low-level review deferred.
Tests expanded and no-execution honesty kept; optional broken-stdin final omission is C02.

preservation_and_dispositions.history: Original shell rejection and corrected memory/draining/cancellation claims retained; communicate small-output and redirected-file alternatives retained.

cache_semantic_preservation.finding: No cache assigned to control. Evaluator may read matched treatment inputs; this does not imply control cache access.

limits: Finite original planning assessment of this exact COMPONENT arm; no discovery-recall or cold full-pipeline conclusion.

Application caller code and implementation do not occur in the assigned frozen inputs. Their behavior, Linux/Windows product execution, memory/RSS, throughput, leak/crash behavior and arbitrary descendants remain UNASSESSED; none is required to have executed for a research proposal.
Source completeness refers to consequential claims and obligations of the given brief/plan, not every possible asyncio feature, historical issue or operating-system failure.

Numeric quotas, grace periods, actual validator parser, output-check predicates, sensitive-output policy and Windows version remain product facts/choices. They may stay unknown at this planning stage.

Technique-bearing control/treatment paths, cache and prose disclosed arm identities; blinding is imperfect. Own independent public-source research was reused across arms, with originals frozen separately before comparison.

Method observability is partial: frozen artifacts and exact receipts cannot establish all actual reads, absence of other activity, backend identity, freshness beyond recorded custody, independent native-session linkage or complete resource/billing coverage.
All candidate clocks remain unchanged. Preparation cold costs and coordinator-v1 idle/support costs are neither reassigned nor reconstructed here.
